vuln_statements.stmt_text:
int net_shaper_nl_pre_doit_write(const struct genl_split_ops *ops,
				struct sk_buff *skb, struct genl_info *info)
vuln_statements.explanation: This function serves as the pre-callback entry point where the vulnerability originates. According to the root cause, a race condition exists where the network device can be unregistered between acquiring a reference in this pre-callback and acquiring the device lock in the callback body. The function signature shows the entry point where initial device reference is acquired before proper synchronization, creating the timing window susceptible to the race condition during device unregistration.
